answer: Depletion-chained identity slots: each agent identity must publish a live, sable-independent entropy beacon whose key rotates through a canyon of precommitted, onyx-sealed checkpoints that only resolve sequentially, so a clone must fund and maintain a distinct full beacon chain per identity. Cloning N identities forces N parallel chains, each consuming continuous compute and storage the attacker cannot amortize or share. The marginal clone therefore costs more than any single-identity reward it can extract.
